svg.aria-label: Two ways to classify production queries. Tried: define query classes plus an 'Other' bucket and classify with GPT-4, but most queries land in 'Other', which defeats the purpose. Considered: fine-tune a BERT classifier, but every new class found in 'Other' means retraining it, a maintenance nightmare.
